title: 生物多样性与土地利用
summary: 评估公司运营对生物多样性和土地的影响，包括破坏、修复承诺与绩效。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Biodiversity & Land Use Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Biodiversity & Land Use is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. MSCI S&C evaluates companies on the potential impact of their operations on biodiversity in their areas of operation and their efforts to manage the environmental impact of their operations.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍生物多样性与土地利用关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）¹ 如何形成评估结果。生物多样性与土地利用属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型环境支柱下的关键议题。MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队评估公司运营对所在地区生物多样性的潜在影响，以及公司管理运营环境影响的措施。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.

sections.title_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用管理框架

blocks.content: The table below outlines the indicators mapped to their respective components that inform the Biodiversity & Land Use Management score, excluding controversies. MSCI S&C assigns each indicator a default weight. Indicator weights may be adjusted at the company level to reflect the relevance of the indicator to the company’s business activities. If a company has no exposure to the business activities covered by an indicator, the indicator is assigned a weight of zero.

sections.title_en: Biodiversity & Land Use Management score
sections.title_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用管理得分

blocks.content: The Biodiversity & Land Use Management score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the weighted average of the score associated with each relevant indicator, modified by Controversies.
blocks.content_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用管理得分评估公司管理此议题风险敞口的能力。该得分以各相关指标得分的加权平均值为基础，并通过争议事件进行调整。

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice and 0 corresponding to lack of management. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.
blocks.content_cn: 该得分来自采用 0—10 分制的指标，10 分对应最佳实践，0 分对应缺乏管理。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“风险管理分析”章节。除另有说明外，数据均来自公司披露。

sections.title_en: Biodiversity & Land Use Policy & Disclosure score
sections.title_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用政策与披露得分

blocks.content: The Biodiversity & Land Use Policy & Disclosure score evaluates the company’s disclosure of biodiversity and land use policies, including commitments to habitat restoration, minimizing disturbances, engagement with external stakeholders or standard to address the biodiversity impacts of operations. it is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用政策与披露得分评估公司对相关政策的披露，包括生境修复、减少扰动、与外部利益相关方合作或采用标准应对运营生物多样性影响等承诺。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

blocks.content: • Involvement with external stakeholder groups to address the biodiversity impacts of its operations
blocks.content_cn: • 与外部利益相关方合作应对运营对生物多样性的影响

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there are external stakeholder groups that work with the company to address the biodiversity impacts of its operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明是否有外部利益相关方团体与公司合作，应对其运营对生物多样性的影响。

blocks.content: • Scope of third-party engagement or standard to address the biodiversity impacts of operations
blocks.content_cn: • 应对运营生物多样性影响的第三方参与或标准覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated share of operations with ecosystem protection programs certified or assured by an external stakeholder group.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算运营中生态系统保护计划获得外部利益相关方团体认证或鉴证的比例。

sections.title_en: • Commitment to minimize disturbances on biodiversity
sections.title_cn: • 尽量减少对生物多样性扰动的承诺

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed an explicit commitment to minimize disturbances on biodiversity, for example following the mitigation hierarchy of “avoid, minimize, restore and offset.”
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否披露了尽量减少对生物多样性扰动的明确承诺，例如遵循“避免、减少、修复和抵消”的减缓层级。

sections.title_en: • Commitment to reclaim habitat on disturbed land
sections.title_cn: • 修复受扰动土地生境的承诺

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed an explicit policy to eventually reclaim the habitat of all disturbed land.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否披露明确政策，承诺最终修复所有受扰动土地的生境。

sections.title_en: • Scope of biodiversity and land reclamation policy
sections.title_cn: • 生物多样性与土地复垦政策的覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of operations covered by the company’s disclosed biodiversity and land reclamation policy, where applicable (i.e., all operations including its supply chain, all direct operations, or partial operations).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司披露的生物多样性与土地复垦政策所覆盖的运营范围（如适用），即包括供应链在内的全部运营、全部直接运营，或部分运营。

sections.title_en: Biodiversity & Land Use Programs & Structures score
sections.title_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用计划与组织架构得分

blocks.content: The Biodiversity & Land Programs & Structures score evaluates the company’s ability to manage biodiversity impacts through structured programs and practices, including ecosystem protection initiatives and biodiversity impact assessments for new operations. it is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用计划与组织架构得分评估公司通过系统性计划和实践管理生物多样性影响的能力，包括生态系统保护举措及新运营项目的生物多样性影响评估。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Extent of programs to protect ecosystems
sections.title_cn: • 生态系统保护计划的覆盖程度

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the comprehensiveness of the company’s steps to protect ecosystems, for example, whether the company creates ecosystem reserves vs. isolated initiatives to protect single species, and whether such practices apply to all major sites or only selected operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司保护生态系统措施的全面程度，例如公司是否建立生态系统保护区，还是仅采取保护单一物种的独立举措；以及这些措施适用于所有主要场所，还是仅适用于选定运营。

sections.title_en: • Conducts biodiversity impact assessments
sections.title_cn: • 开展生物多样性影响评估

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company conducts biodiversity impact assessments prior to settling in new areas.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否在进入新地区之前开展生物多样性影响评估。

sections.title_en: Biodiversity & Land Use Performance score
sections.title_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用绩效得分

blocks.content: The Biodiversity & Land Use Performance score evaluates the company's performance on biodiversity & land use metrics (oil spill intensity) relative to its peers. It is expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用绩效得分评估公司生物多样性与土地利用指标（溢油强度）相对于同行的表现。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Oil spills performance relative to peers
sections.title_cn: • 相对于同行的溢油表现

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on oil spills intensity (normalized by sales), and trend in oil spills intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司溢油强度（按销售额标准化）及其变化趋势相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: ◦ Oil spill intensity industry relative score
sections.title_cn: ◦ 溢油强度行业相对得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on oil spill intensity metrics (total volume of oil spilled normalized by sales) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司溢油强度指标（按销售额标准化的溢油总量）相对于行业同业的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Three-year average oil spill intensity (sales based)
sections.title_cn: • 三年平均溢油强度（按销售额计）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average oil spill intensity, calculated as total oil spill volume per unit of sales.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司的三年平均溢油强度，即单位销售额的溢油总量。

sections.title_en: ◦ Oil spill intensity industry relative trend score
sections.title_cn: ◦ 溢油强度趋势行业相对得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year trend in oil spill intensity (year-over-year change in oil spill volume normalized by sales) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司溢油强度三年变化趋势（按销售额标准化的溢油量同比变化）相对于行业同业的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Three-year average year-over-year oil spill intensity trend (sales based)
sections.title_cn: • 溢油强度同比变化趋势的三年平均值（按销售额计）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company’s three-year trend in oil spill intensity.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司溢油强度的三年变化趋势。

sections.title_en: Controversies
sections.title_cn: 争议事件

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management score based on the severity, status, and the company’s role in the controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The result is the Management score. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment:
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在此关键议题上所涉争议的严重程度、状态及公司在其中的角色，从总体管理得分中扣减 0—5 分，得到管理得分。评估采用以下争议类别：

blocks.content: • Biodiversity & land use controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 生物多样性与土地利用争议事件。

blocks.content: • Oil spills.
blocks.content_cn: • 溢油。

blocks.content: • Toxic releases to water/land controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 向水体或土地排放有毒物质的争议。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to Section: Controversies cases, of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于争议如何纳入 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“争议案例”章节。

sections.title_en: Biodiversity & Land Use Exposure score
sections.title_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Biodiversity & Land Use Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure scores. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to Section: Analyzing risk exposure, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 生物多样性与土地利用风险敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的风险敞口，以业务和地域风险敞口得分为基础。地域风险敞口得分作为业务风险敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。业务与地域风险敞口得分均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高风险，0 分对应最低风险。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“风险敞口分析”章节。风险敞口得分按以下公式计算：

sections.title_en: Business Segment Exposure scores
sections.title_cn: 业务板块敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by a simple average of the Biodiversity Business Impacts score and the Controversies score of the business activity.
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分。各业务活动得分由该活动的生物多样性业务影响得分与争议得分的简单平均值确定。

blocks.content: $B B I S _ { j }$ is the Biodiversity Business Impacts score for business activity j.
blocks.content_cn: $B B I S _ { j }$ 为业务活动 j 的生物多样性业务影响得分。

blocks.content: $C S _ { j }$ is the Controversies score for business activity j.
blocks.content_cn: $C S _ { j }$ 为业务活动 j 的争议得分。

blocks.content: The Biodiversity Business Impacts score of a business activity is assessed by examining the business impacts that are present for that activity. Nine business impacts arising from biodiversity and ecosystem changes are considered such as disruption of operations, restricted access to land and resources and litigation. For each business activity, each impact is presented as a 0 or 1 value, with 1 indicating that the impact is present. The number of impacts that apply to each activity is counted and scaled to a factor of 10 to calculate the Biodiversity Business Impacts score.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的生物多样性业务影响得分通过考察该活动面临的业务影响进行评估。评估考虑生物多样性和生态系统变化引起的九类业务影响，例如运营中断、土地与资源获取受限以及诉讼。对各项业务活动，每种影响赋值为 0 或 1，1 表示存在该影响。统计各活动适用的影响数量，并换算至 10 分尺度，以计算生物多样性业务影响得分。

blocks.content: The Controversies score of a business activity is determined by the percentage of companies involved in a biodiversity controversy assessed as Moderate to Very Severe among all the companies with the same primary business activity.3 Refer to Section: Controversies cases, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for details on how the severity of controversy cases is assessed.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的争议得分由具有相同主营业务活动的所有公司中，涉及严重程度为中等至极严重的生物多样性争议的公司比例确定³。有关争议案例严重程度的评估详情，参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“争议案例”章节。
